title: Lipid bilayer induces contraction of the denatured state ensemble of a helical-bundle membrane protein.
authors: Gaffney, Kristen A; Guo, Ruiqiong; Bridges, Michael D; Muhammednazaar, Shaima; Chen, Daoyang; Kim, Miyeon; Yang, Zhongyu; Schilmiller, Anthony L; Faruk, Nabil F; Peng, Xiangda; Jones, A Daniel; Kim, Kelly H; Sun, Liangliang; Hubbell, Wayne L; Sosnick, Tobin R; Hong, Heedeok
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
one_liner_zh: 该文研究膜蛋白GlpG在脂质双层中的变性态系综，聚焦膜蛋白折叠与脂质环境效应，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Defining the denatured state ensemble (DSE) and disordered proteins is essential to understanding folding, chaperone action, degradation, and translocation. As compared with water-soluble proteins, the DSE of membrane proteins is much less characterized. Here, we measure the DSE of the helical membrane protein GlpG of Escherichia coli (E. coli) in native-like lipid bilayers. The DSE was obtained using our steric trapping method, which couples denaturation of doubly biotinylated GlpG to binding of two streptavidin molecules. The helices and loops are probed using limited proteolysis and mass spectrometry, while the dimensions are determined using our paramagnetic biotin derivative and double electron-electron resonance spectroscopy. These data, along with our Upside simulations, identify the DSE as being highly dynamic, involving the topology changes and unfolding of some of the transmembrane (TM) helices. The DSE is expanded relative to the native state but only to 15 to 75% of the fully expanded condition. The degree of expansion depends on the local protein packing and the lipid composition. E. coli's lipid bilayer promotes the association of TM helices in the DSE and, probably in general, facilitates interhelical interactions. This tendency may be the outcome of a general lipophobic effect of proteins within the cell membranes.
abstract_zh: 定义变性态系综（denatured state ensemble, DSE）和无序蛋白对于理解折叠、伴侣作用、降解和转位至关重要。与水溶性蛋白相比，膜蛋白的DSE特征化程度要低得多。在此，我们测量了螺旋膜蛋白GlpG（来自大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli, E. coli））在类天然脂质双层中的DSE。DSE通过我们的空间捕获方法获得，该方法将双生物素化GlpG的变性偶联至两个链霉亲和素分子的结合。螺旋和环区通过有限蛋白水解和质谱法探测，而尺寸则通过我们的顺磁生物素衍生物和双电子-电子共振光谱法确定。这些数据连同我们的Upside模拟，将DSE识别为高度动态的，涉及拓扑变化和部分跨膜（transmembrane, TM）螺旋的去折叠。DSE相对于天然状态是扩张的，但仅达到完全扩张条件的15%至75%。扩张程度取决于局部蛋白堆积和脂质组成。大肠杆菌的脂质双层促进DSE中TM螺旋的关联，并且可能普遍促进螺旋间相互作用。这种趋势可能是细胞膜内蛋白质普遍疏脂效应的结果。
